findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_authored_story, make_playable, resolve_media, get_story_audio · Private data: create_authored_story, make_playable, steer_session, create_playlist, save_session, prepare_episode, manage_owned_item, get_story_audio · Public sink: create_authored_story, get_story_audio · Destructive: get_session, manage_owned_item.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_authored_story, make_playable, resolve_media, get_story_audio · Private data: create_authored_story, make_playable, steer_session, create_playlist, save_session, prepare_episode, manage_owned_item, get_story_audio · Public sink: create_authored_story, get_story_audio · Destructive: get_session, manage_owned_item

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
